svg.text: AUTOWARE — the software stack (everything inside is what you design)
Every arrow here is DATA flow. Power and mechanical flow do not appear — and that is correct, because
Autoware is software. The vehicle has a power architecture; this stack does not. Say so; do not just omit it.
Deliberately NOT in v1, stated in their own docs: fail-safe, HMI, real-time processing, redundancy, state monitoring.
